notes.title: Update #12 - Level-Up Screen Rework - First Pass - v0.7.3
notes.content: [p][b]Hey Loners,[/b][/p][p]We just pushed a new update focused on visual clarity and game feel. This patch upgrades how level progression looks and reads in the middle of the action, from player power-ups to enemy threats.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Highlights[/h3][p][b] • Level-up screen completely overhauled[/b][/p][p] • Evolution indicators added to streamline build planning[/p][p] • Purify layout redesigned for a cleaner interface[/p][p]• On-screen animations for Curios when triggered[/p][p] • New Banish visual effects[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/30f8b76c5f21d6ea5011ea6ce30ce3db936a8253.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p] [b]Enemy level-up colors redesigned for clarity[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/d35ef148a32991e4c16f252ed5a14473b3885923.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]What's New[/h2][p][b]Visual and Audio Updates[/b][/p][p]• New background track added: [b][i]White Wing[/i][/b] [/p][p]• New sound effects for Warren[/p][p] • Burn effects are now visible on player characters[/p][p] • Brightness adjustments for weapon muzzle flashes and enemy deaths[/p][p] • Seizure warning layout updated[/p][p] • Revenge buff now displays a clear activation animation[/p][p] • Brightness adjustments on Taka-chan effects[/p][p]• Miniboss Charles VFX improved for clarity[/p][p][/p][h2]Gameplay Changes[/h2][p]• Elite enemies in Viridity Pass now launch mortar attacks[/p][p]• Events are blocked from spawning during boss fights[/p][p]• Pebble drops are now limited per run; deposits no longer respawn indefinitely[/p][p][/p][h2]Fixes[/h2][p]• Music Box now plays correctly when the related event is activated[/p][p]• Fixes applied to the level-up screen, mainly related to controller interaction.[/p][p][/p][h2]Known Issues[/h2][p]• Receiving a -75 Max Health debuff from an Offering can reduce health below zero, freezing enemy AI[/p][p]• Taka-Chan shows the same Evolution multiple times when upgrade limit is exceeded, but no upgrade is granted[/p][p][/p][h2]Director's commentary[/h2][p]Hey everyone, we're back for another round of updates! This time we're addressing a huge point of pain from the community: more Information![/p][p]You all wanted to have more clarity on how to evolve Curios, and we're delivering that on our brand new Level Up Screen![/p][p]The UI team has been cooking this for a while, but it doesn't stop here! We are preparing some other things for this new screen! You can expect it to give you even more information so you can make better decisions on your run! Can't wait to share more on our next update ;)[/p][p][/p][p]Let us know what you think in the comments below![/p][p] [/p][p]That’s it for now,[/p][p]Go have a Picnic![/p]

notes.title: Update #11 - Optimizations, Clouds in the Sky and New Offerings - v0.7.2
notes.content:
[p]Hey [b]Loners[/b],
New skies, new tricks, new ways to break the rules.
[/p][p]Here’s what’s cooking in Atomic Picnic:
[/p][h3][b]Visuals & QoL[/b][/h3][p]We rewrote the sky. Literally.[/p][p]New visuals up there. Cleaner effects everywhere else. Most of the VFX in the game got optimized.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/7202638b9d9afc9c9824d49a17ade278a1ca2c6c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/01ae7bcdcbbb741136a2e4ef930f04e41285cfc4.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Systems & Stuff That Makes Life Better[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The Offerings event has a new twist. No more paying with HP. Now you trade 30 seconds of nasty debuffs for the Memento of your choice. Worth it? That’s your call.
[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/16ff4dee9f106a737de215deb66897903fe13ced.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Tutorial’s tighter. Added a nudge on how to use active skills. Some of you needed it.[/p][/*][*][p]Fall off the map? You won’t be crawling back from the start anymore. Respawn closer. Less pain. More game.[/p][/*][*][p]Paulão’s shop now stocks upgrades for every single Memento. He’s expanding!
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Sounds & SFX[/b][/h3][p]Mini-boss Charles and the Charger enemy finally found their voices.[/p][p]Now they scream properly, and you can hear them coming.
[/p][h3][b]Fixes That Actually Matter[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Gold Goblin no longer gets stuck doing absolutely nothing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fire Devil’s missing buff icon is back from vacation.[/p][/*][*][p]Shadows on some character areas in camp while playing as a client, and the host didn't have those characters unlocked[/p][/*][/list][p][b] Diamantina got a cleanup[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fewer cheesy safe spots[/p][list][*][p]Better step-ups[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some collisions[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Warren’s loot should stay inside the map now.[/p][/*][*][p]Warren also remembered how to use all his attacks. About time.
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Known Issues[/b][/h3][p]Taka-Chan sometimes shows you three of the same evolution when you go over the upgrade cap. And then gives you none. We see it. It’s on the list.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Director's commentary[/b][/h3][p]Performance upgrades! I managed to play with around ~35 FPS on MAX settings on my Steam Deck after this update; it was amazing! The VFX and Programming team successfully reduced the footprint of all our VFX by an incredible amount, enabling some team members who previously had 10 FPS to achieve 30 FPS, which is [b]CRAZY[/b]![/p][p] [/p][p]As always, we will continue to add more features and expand the game based on the community's feedback. We have some exciting features planned for our next major release, and we're fully focused on that. It'll take a while, tho. Meanwhile, some additional features will be introduced next, including an improved Level Up screen and changes to the deposits found throughout the map.[/p][p] [/p][p]That’s it for now.[/p][p] Go break the game. Or at least try.[/p]

notes.title: Update #9 - Tooltips System, UI, and Multiplayer Improvements - v0.6.4
notes.content:
Hey Loners, time for a new update!

This time, we wanted to address two major pieces of feedback from the Community: explaining some mechanics and improving Networking. 

For the first one, we're releasing a new Tooltip system, where you can read about how some mechanics work during level up! (Leave us suggestions on how we can improve the tooltips!). 

About Networking, we've also done a lot of work behind the scenes to improve reliability and overall code performance, so please try playing some matches with friends and let us know how it goes!

[h3]What’s New
[/h3][b]1. Tooltip System[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]New Feature:[/b] Hover over upgrades during level-up to see explanations of stats and mechanics.
[*] [b]Toggleable:[/b] Defaults to ON! Disable in settings if you crave mystery.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/ad2ee32b9034c9f61a743d4345dd176f11444a47.png[/img]
[b]2. Multiplayer Improvements[/b][list]
[*] Smoother networking, performance optimizations, and stability fixes.
[*] [b]Added Picnic Finder:[/b] a feature to help squad assembly (feedback welcome!).
[/list]
[b]3. Party Health HUD[/b]
[list]
[*] Keep tabs on allies’ HP during co-op chaos. No more shouting, “ARE YOU ALIVE?!”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/bc7dff8a91d9701503f9c26da0fab9c56bb0c285.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[b]4. Audio Upgrades[/b][list]
[*] [b]Rose Skills SFX:[/b] Now you can listen to the captain bringing hell. 
[*] [b]Discovery Unlock SFX[/b][/list]
[h3]Quality of Life:[/h3][b]1. Fire Devil VFX[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]New Texture & Flaming Wings VFX:[/b] This Curio now radiates molten menace. Fly through the air, burning it all.
[/list]
[b]2. Enhanced Stats & UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Tab Screen Additions:
[list] [*] [b]Stats Duration:[/b] Track buff/debuff timers.
[*] [b]Magazine Size:[/b] Monitor ammo capacity changes mid-fight.
[/list][/list][list]
[*] [b]Revamped Mementos UI:[/b] Darker, grittier, and aligned with the game’s apocalyptic vibe.[/list]
[h3]Changes & Balancing
[/h3][list]
[*] [b]Revenge (Assimiliar):[/b]
[list]
[*] Debuff now triggers on ANY damage taken (not just enemy hits).
[*] Now the curio can target multiple enemies. Turn pain into payback.
[/list]
[*] [b]Tracking Sniper:[/b] Now prioritizes enemies closest to your crosshair (not the player). Aim matters.
[*] [b]Picnic Start Changed:[/b]  Now, even when playing by yourself, your Picnic won't start automatically after choosing a map.[/list][h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed our sorting algorithm based on distance (used on TrackingSniper and several upgrades).
[*] Fixed Rose's drone not working with Tracking Sniper Weapon Mod.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented some players from unlocking maps after defeating a Boss in multiplayer.[/list][b]City of Sands:[/b] Replaced jarring metal textures on Settlements A/C. [i]Immersion restored.[/i]

[h3]Known Issues:
[/h3][list]
[*] Some players might experience slight stuttering when using the Air Gear or ledge grabbing during very intense Picnics. 
[*] Picking up multiple Cursed Curios that increase the Damage Taken Stat can instantly kill players at 21+ HP when picking up an Offering.
[*] Area of Effect VFX replays briefly after the initial effect ends on any AoE source.
[*] When switching between mouse and gamepad on the level-up screen, the button to open/close the tooltip details might appear incorrect: "D-pad down" or "X."
[*] Some players might experience the UI disappearing when playing multiplayer; restarting the game can fix this.
[*] Rose's skills functionality information is outdated in the Quick Help menu and the Loadout screen.
[*] When using Air Gear for the second time near a ledge, your character can fly super high.
[*] If a character does damage while using Air Gear and has a curio that does the same, the Damage Per Second won't be displayed on the End Game Screen.
[*] Paulão's Shop spawns empty, forcing immediate restock.
[/list]
[h3]Director Commentary
[/h3]Hey Loners, Edu here!

We've just released our newest [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1903560/Atomic_Picnic/]Roadmap[/url]. Did you see it? 

There are a lot of new things coming up on the next Major Update, but right now, my focus is on what's beyond. I want to tackle things like Picnic Events and Picnic Objectives, and I'd love to hear from you in the comments below what you would like to see changed or added to how Objectives or Events work. Which ones do you hate, which ones do you love, and what would you change or add? Hit us up below!

[b]Join the Picnic
[/b]Share feedback, report bugs, and showcase your builds on our forums or Discord. Your input shapes the future of the game.
[h3]Stay Connected
[/h3]We invite players to join the conversation and share their thoughts on the update:

Our second Major Update is approaching, so it's time to freshen up our Roadmap! Big thanks to all the Loners who have been playing Atomic Picnic during Early Access! The team’s been glued to your feedback, scouring forums, reviews, streams, and every spicy take you’ve dropped. Y’all are the real MVPs, and we’re cooking up fixes and surprises. Let’s dive in!

[i]Check the bottom of the post for the Roadmap Infographic!
[/i]
[h3]Priority Fixes
[/h3]The game has evolved fast, but we can't stop here. You guys have been very vocal about what we need to improve, so here's a list of what we've been working on, according to our community feedback.

[h3]More Build Diversity[/h3]
[list]
[*] Since the last Roadmap news, we added weapon mods, and the Major Update 2 will bring a new pack of goodies to make your builds more unique than ever. This will give you more control over winning a picnic in all crazy styles. You can expect A LOT of new Evolutions and even some new Curios thrown in the mix ;)
[/list]
[h3]Networking issues
[/h3]We've read the comments, the negative reviews, and you've even sent us more than 1.2 THOUSAND replies on our feedback form... We understand that you want better reliability on Multiplayer Matches and ways to find more players to play the game with. That's coming... SOON.

[h3]Balancing (Harder, Faster, Better, Stronger)
[/h3] [list]
[*] A significant point in our next Major Update is a complete rebalance and improvements of our underlying Enemy Spawner. We hear your feedback about the game feeling slow-paced and grindy, and that it can be a slog! We are working on many new things to make it faster-paced and with more consistent enemy progression. 
[*] Our new update aims to make the matches faster overall and with quicker objectives. That means objectives with fewer things to do (time, health, counts) and enemies dying faster. However, simultaneously, it also means the rest of the game will be a bit harder. Please look forward to some more pain.   
[/list]
[h3]Progression Tweaks
[/h3][list]
[*] Between the first Major Update and the second, we've already made many adjustments to Discoveries and Curios, and we even added a new map, Viridity Pass, to smooth out the game's first-time experience. This is all to address some community feedback about the overall game progression. We'll keep working on it till it's perfect for final release, so keep those comments flowing.
[/list][h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] The UI team has done a TON of work, from reworking the entire gameplay HUD to creating the new Tab and loadout explainer (press F1). One major question from the players was about what each thing does and how they work: like, what does [b]Burn[/b], [b]Chill[/b], or [b]Doom[/b] do? What does the [b]Quantity[/b] or [b]Probability[/b] stat do? Well, soon we're releasing a Tooltips system to explain everything to you! And way more UI improvements are coming to the game as we head to the second Major Update and beyond!
[/list]
[h3]Roadmap Sneak Peek
[/h3][b]New Content Rolling Out Soon:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]5 Wild Evolutions:[/b] Icy dash explosions, black hole shenanigans, revenge totems, chaos upgraded.
[*] [b]New Map - Diamantina:[/b] Fall into the Abyss, respawn, repeat. It’s a feature, not a bug.
[*] [b]New Enemies:[/b] Vacuum, Beyblade (spin-to-win, but you lose).
[*] [b]Boss Alert:[/b] City of Sands now has a giant worm. Bring a toothbrush or your sniper.
[*] [b]Curios:[/b] Reload shurikens, fiery “don’t touch me” armor.
[/list]
[b]Want to help shape the game?[/b] Crash our Discord, yell at us on Steam, or send carrier pigeons. We’re here for it.
Stay tuned! Updates drop faster than Hani’s nerf hammer.

[b]The Atomic Picnic Crew
[/b][i]P.S. Roadmap details subject to change.[/i]

notes.title: Atomic at the BRIndies Bundle!!
notes.content:
[h2]BRIndies launches its first Game Bundle packed with must-play titles for the Brazilian market this April [/h2]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/9d6033b81bfa06c2f3ddb4e3669657e11b8f3967.png[/img]

April is heating up with major news: [b]Soulstone Survivors[/b], the hit roguelike, is officially leaving Early Access and making its console debut on June 17, launching simultaneously on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series. Also featured in the bundle are [b]Enigma of Fear[/b], a haunting puzzle-horror experience with a chilling atmosphere; [b]Pocket Bravery[/b], a retro-inspired fighter with modern mechanics, nominated for The Game Awards 2023; and [b]Mullet Madjack[/b], a high-octane, '90s anime-style action game that just landed on Xbox! And, [b]Atomic Picnic[/b], a roguelike shooter that just dropped a fresh update packed with new content for players to dive into.


[b]Atomic Picnic (BitCake Studio/Mad Mushroom)[/b]: You know who Ash, Rose, and the picnic crew are.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/34e3cf794ab457c23ad2c648dfbf126999f8fad1.png[/img]

[b]Enigma of Fear (Dumativa/Nuuvem)[/b]: Step into the role of Mia, a paranormal detective on a mission to find her missing father. With the help of her loyal dog, Lupi, dive into the investigation of the Cult of Fear in a world that blends 3D aesthetics with the charm of pixel art, creating an immersive, mystery-filled experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/2b446dcbfc0e9e1637dde1c65b48624a87585196.png[/img]

[b]Mullet Madjack (HAMMER95/Epopeia Games)[/b]: A fast-paced FPS that drops you straight into a VHS-era anime! Power up your character and push your skills to the limit as you fight to the top floor, facing off against relentless enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/16730f55751dda77c43a778acf5c9d9d0b0fd3e2.png[/img]

[b]Pocket Bravery (Statera Studio/PQube)[/b]: An original SD-style fighting game featuring charismatic characters and vibrant visuals. Its combat system is inspired by '90s classics, making it a perfect pick for seasoned fighters and newcomers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/aad44bf579e79cbe32f07ba4532bde78ebef710c.png[/img]

[b]Soulstone Survivors (Game Smithing Ltd.)[/b]: Face the Lords of the Void and their endless minions, collect Soulstones, and ascend to godhood! Uncover hidden spells, forge powerful weapons, and discover unique synergies in this action-packed roguelite.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/5a0e1db64f920ffb4e1d615bbda40fee4726c044.png[/img]

notes.title: Update #7 - New Map, New Weapon Skill, Ash Rework and More! - v0.6.2
notes.content:
Hey Loners,

This update delivers fresh content, a reworked Ash, polished mechanics, and community-requested fixes to elevate your journey. Dive into the details below.

[h1]Viridity Pass – A New Frontier[/h1]
[b]Explore:[/b] A sprawling starting map filled with open paths, dynamic challenges, and untapped resources. Perfect for testing new strategies and for a fast understanding of the game.
[list]
[*] [b]Viridity Pass[/b] will replace Train Plateau as the first map the players experience in Atomic Picnic. Train Plateau will be unlocked via Discoveries. Also, to streamline the user experience, Viridity Pass will not feature a Boss Fight; completing the map requires only 2 Main Objectives.
[*] Notice: [b]Train Plateau[/b] might be locked for you once this update goes live. Just beat Viridity Pass to unlock it!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/5db14b4fdda6ca20d68eee5c3ab351153c120eb9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/30f68e649545b31d0739b8a10c3c90a66d6349a3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/36ba481a5b84c849918e7a1274768d0caac724cc.jpg[/img]

[h1]Evolution System Improvements[/h1]
[b]Unlock & Adapt:[/b] Discover evolution recipes mid-run via the ESC menu.
[list]
[*] If more than one evolution has been found, the remaining will be displayed encrypted in the Atomic Font.
[*] New players: Unlock your first evolution to reveal the system.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/0cdca3162f8cfd9c70c33ce541c115beb99a26bf.jpg[/img]

[b]New Cursed Curios[/b]
We've remade some of the less-used Cursed Curios and created new ones with 2 brand-new stats!
[list]
[*] [b]Weapon Skill Fill[/b] - The higher it is the faster your Weapon Skill will charge!
[*] [b]Weapon Skill Charges[/b] - The higher it is the more times you can use your Weapon Skill!
[/list]

[h1]New Weapon Skill[/h1]
[h2][b]Wind Blast[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] A great weapon against a group of smaller enemies! Enemies hit by its effect will receive damage and knockback!
[*] The more charges it consumes when activated, the higher the effect!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/368480bfb4c6a07e98642a9bb108cac56a5ce6d6.gif[/img]

[h1]Key Additions[/h1]
[h2]Combat & Progression[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Unstuck Mechanic:[/b] Escape terrain traps (10s delay, 3min cooldown). Activate it on the ESC Menu.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/1a461378aacdf8d00e0bec829648d950159b1585.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Weapon Mod Visuals:[/b] Enhanced VFX for mods like Sniper Trampoline to match their impact.
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Tab Menu Stats:[/b] Monitor your build’s stats in real time.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/633391ad3299463fc37f62b227c3550e26150517.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]New Enemy Healthbar:[/b] Elite, Normal, and Mini-Bosses now have different healthbars. Mini-Boss bars now persist throughout the combat!
[*] [b]Combat Polish:[/b] Smoother dodging, absorbing, and UI responsiveness.
[i]We reworked the Gear Dash Colliders and Mechanics, so it's easier to take advantage of Dodge-related Curios like Good Times.[/i]
[/list]

[h2]Visual & Immersion Upgrades[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Snowbro Redesign:[/b] A chilling new model for Alternate Actuality.
[*] [b]Loading Screen Poses:[/b] Dynamic character art to set the tone.
[*] [b]UI Revamp:[/b] Sleeker menus with animated backgrounds.
[/list]


[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Bosses and Minibosses cannot be stunned by One-Eyed Whirli Curio anymore
[/list]
[h3]Weapon Mods now need to be unlocked via Discoveries![/h3]
[list]
[*] As we said before, the Trial period for Weapon Mods is over now, and all players need to unlock them via Discoveries now!
[*] But for those of you who have been playing since the last update, you might've already reached the Discovery Threshold to unlock them, resulting in an auto-unlock!
[/list]
[h3]Ash's abilities and skills have been overhauled![/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Scout (Passive):[/b] Ash has one extra Air Gear charge. Every time Ash uses Air Gear or Gear Bomb she gains a cumulative Movement Speed buff stack, max 10 stacks. Stacks are lost over time.
[*] [b]On the Prowl (Passive):[/b] Whenever Ash moves a certain distance, gain a Fire Rate Buff stack, max 10 stacks. Stacks are lost over time.
[*] [b]Flare (Passive):[/b] When Ash uses her last Air Gear Charge, her arm emits a special glow in an area around her. When a player touches or enters the area, they gain the Flare buff. When a Player with the Flare buff defeats an enemy, that Player's Air Gear cooldown is reduced by 0.2 sec.
[*] [b]Dash Bomb (Active - Level 2):[/b] Every enemy hit creates a minor explosion. Gear Bomb damage now also multiplies based on Ash's Movement Speed modifier.
[/list]
[h3]Discoveries balancing changes: [/h3]
[list]
[*] Damage Mult: 300 > 1.000
[*] Pebbles A3: 10.000 > 80.000
[*] Shotgun: 150 > 100 ; removed constraint (play in train plateau)
[*] JD: 200 > 400
[*] Attraction: 1200 > 5000
[*] Pebbles E2: 5.000 > 20.000 ; 500 > 1.000
[*] FireRate: 80 > 100
[*] Cooldown Reduction: 10 > 25
[*] Reroll: 30 > 36
[/list]

[h1]Community-Driven Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Paulão Shop: There was a bug allowing Players to buy more items and upgrades than the cap allowed; the bug has been fixed, and the value has been updated to a maximum of 10 of a specific stat.
[*] The critical hit SFX now correctly plays when a critical hit defeats an enemy.
[*] Twister VFX now correctly stops when pausing the game.
[*] Fixed Incorrect Prompt for Curios Screen: "Touch Pad" Shown Instead of "Share" on PS5 Controller.
[*] Fixed PS5 controller glyphs. The scroll button was showing the Left Stick glyph instead of the Right Stick.
[*] Fixed Level up SFX playing in a loop when returning to camp via the ESC menu.
[*] Fixed Throwing Knifes Crosshair overlapping Weapon Skill Charges on UI.
[*] Removed a random explosion sound when healing shrine despawns.
[*] Fixed Deposits spawn overlapping other Deposits.
[*] Fixed Events spawn overlapping other events, often preventing completion.
[*] Fixed the terrain on the Tutorial map being more elevated than expected.
[*] Fixed Jonathan's health bar not being displayed for clients.
[*] Fixed Combat text and HP not being displayed for Mini Jelly and its egg.
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*] Unexpected Offerings Event and Cursed Curios Synergy: Stacking negative Damage Taken modifiers may trigger instant death if you accept an offering since its damage will be higher than 20hp and could kill you. Hotfix inbound! Meanwhile make sure you have enough health when picking up offerings!
[*] Discovery Progression: Revives and Events aren't tracking correctly. We are already looking into this!
[*] This might cause issues for some Discovery unlocks and End Game Screen stats.
[*] Ash's Flare VFX is not final and will be reworked in the near future.
[*] Music Box SFX is not playing consistently
[/list]

[h1]Director's Commentary[/h1]
[b]Hey Loners, Edu here![/b]

This is one meaty minor update, right? We managed to squeeze a lot of fixes but also some cool stuff like the complete Ash Skills redesign and a brand new map for new players!

I'm very happy with what we managed to ship this time, but work hasn't stopped. We're doing some experimentation internally for new Curios and Evolutions. There are also a bunch of UI updates that we are also in the pipeline (and that the community has been asking for, btw). Exciting stuff!

One big focus for us on this minor update was the new player experience, but internally, we are also tackling community-related issues such as Solo vs. Multiplayer balancing and how combat will scale later on! Hopefully, I'll be able to share a bit more with you all soon! 

See you at our next Picnic!

[h2]Join the Picnic[/h2]
[i][b]Share feedback, report bugs, and showcase your builds on our forums or Discord. Your input shapes the future of the game.[/b][/i]

[h3]Stay Connected[/h3]
We invite players to join the conversation and share their thoughts on the update:
[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1903560/discussions/]Steam Community Hub[/url]
[*] [url=https://discord.com/invite/atomicpicnic]Discord[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: Update #6 - We hear you! - v0.6.1
notes.content:
Hey Loners,

The major update has passed by, but the work continues. Our next update is packed with exciting new VFX, SFX, visual enhancements, and quality-of-life improvements, many directly requested by our amazing community! 

Here’s a breakdown of what’s new, what’s changed, and what’s been fixed:

[h3]What’s New
[/h3][b]SFX & VFX Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] Added [b]Camille SFX[/b] and [b]Gold Goblin SFX[/b] for a more immersive audio experience.
[*] Introduced Weapon Skill VFX for Throwing Knife, Rocket Launcher, and Ball Lightning which was missing from the last Major update.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/b7870e1eb4831492b3167cc2abc90f0c62f845de.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Updated Blooming Faucet model and VFX (decoy) for better visual clarity.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/aa55f7f58bd19f68b78b4a0377b742db3f07e99e.gif[/img]

[b]Visual Improvements
[/b][list]
[*] [b]New HUD[/b] for life and XP, including a [b]low-life[/b] animation for added tension.
[*] [b]New UI[/b] for the [b]Area Hold Event[/b] to improve readability.
[*] [b]Ammo bar[/b] now displays near the player’s aim for better combat awareness.
[*] [b]New wood windows[/b] were added to concrete buildings in the City of Sands.
[*] Enhanced [b]screen shake and shooting feedback[/b] when using weapon skills.
[*] Updated Rose drone colors and Survivor's Guilty stack VFX for better visual feedback.
[/list]
[b]Quality of Life Improvements
[/b][list]
[*] Added [b]unique crosshairs[/b] for each Weapon Skill to improve usability.
[/list]
[h3]Key Changes
[/h3]The changes below are [b]direct feedback from the community in response to the newest update[/b], which introduced Rose and Weapon Mods. A huge thanks to everyone who spent some time writing their thoughts on our Discord and Steam forums and gave us some amazing feedback! ❤️

[h3]Rose Skill Rework
[/h3]Based on community feedback, Rose’s skills have been rebalanced and improved:
[list]
[*] [b]Survivor's Guilt:[/b] Now gains Stacks of Guilt for every point of damage taken OR healing received. A small Stack % is now partially restored when defeating an enemy after consuming Stacks of Guilt.
[*] [b]Every Shot Counts:[/b] Changed to: Restores more Guilt stacks upon enemy defeat and now allows unlimited stacks.
[*] [b]Mature Mastery:[/b] It now automatically reduces fall speed after X seconds in the air, and Slow Fall will be canceled after shooting.

[h3]Weapon Mods
[/h3][list]
[*] [b]Bubble Shotgun:[/b] Increased range, reduced spread, and higher damage.
[*] [b]Mini-gun:[/b] Bigger magazine size.
[*] [b]Triangle:[/b] Reduced range.
[*] [b]Travel Zooka:[/b] Bigger explosion radius and increased damage.
[*] [b]Tri-Shot:[/b] Increased range, reduced gravity, and higher damage (with less piercing).
[/list]
[h3]Weapon Skills[/h3]
[list]
[*] All mods now require [b]fewer charges[/b] to fill.
[*] [b]Throwing Knife:[/b] Increased base damage and reduced gravity.
[*] [b]Lightning Orb:[/b] Slower movement but higher damage per trigger.
[*] Reworked [b]invulnerability mechanics during dash[/b] to improve interactions with curios like [b]Good Times and Alternate Actuality.[/b]
[list]
[*] Should be easier to do and have a better gameplay feel when dodging attacks! This will also improve dodge-related Discoveries.
[/list]
[/list][h3]Alternate Actuality Changes
[/h3][list]
[*] Players can now [b]detonate each other’s Snowbros.[/b]
[*] Snowbros automatically explode if not dashed through (with reduced chill effect).
[*] Removed tick-to-chill mechanic for Snowbros.
[/list]
[h3]General Rebalancing
[/h3][list]
[*] Rebalanced all curios related to [b]area size.[/b]
[*] [b]Area Hold[/b] icons now fade based on proximity.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
We’ve addressed a variety of bugs and issues reported by the community:
[h3]Fixed currency rewards not being granted for Discoveries (players will receive retroactive rewards).
[/h3][list]
[*] Fixed placeholder image in the "Going On A Picnic" discovery.
[*] Resolved issues with the Discovery tracker failing to progress.
[*] Added missing texture on a specific building in the City of Sands.
[*] Fixed Curio One-Eyed Whirli’s twisters not giving jump bonus for players.
[*] Fixed persistent "Death" skull marks and ping icons on the client’s screen.
[*] Corrected Moon Owner Discovery description showing code strings.
[*] Fixed typo in the Critical Shots Discovery title.
[*] Updated placeholder text in the "Can Take Much Longer" discovery.
[*] Resolved issue where Assimilar marks stayed after enemy death.
[*] Adjusted reload bar appearing on top of Taka-chan animation.
[*] Fixed squad hover state being locked pink while in camp.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/69d4964fe2f91e6ae7cde9fd3288f271e4ec9843.png[/img]
[h3]Director Commentary[/h3]
Hey Loners!

The feedback we've received after our first Major Update was incredible! Our Forums and Discord were filled with new and returning players, all ready to tell us what they loved (and didn't) about the new features! As always, I read through every post on Discord and the Forum and sent them to our team, then we had long heated discussions, changed and rechanged the game, we even did some hardcore playtesting until we couldn't handle it anymore! But in the end I think we're all stronger for it!

Thank you so much for all the amazing words you guys sent. Here's a special thanks to some Discord Players who left some cool feedback: Xcite, Hellblazer, Monarch of Glass, GalaxyPhoenix, and our mod Puddle! 

Cheers,
Edu
Atomic Picnic's Creative Director

[h3]One last thing Loners![/h3]

[b]Atomic is joining the Spring Sale! Spread the love by gifting your friends a copy and inviting them to play together.[/b]

Stay Connected
We invite players to join the conversation and share their thoughts on the update:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1903560]Steam Community Hub
[/url][url=https://discord.com/invite/atomicpicnic]Discord[/url]

Your feedback helps us shape the future of Atomic Picnic.

notes.title: Road to Major Update #1 - Captain Rose
notes.content:
Hey Loners!

We're really excited to release the first Major Update for Atomic Picnic on February 28th, and we want to give you guys a second glimpse into what's coming!

It's a new Character! Captain Rose!

[h1]Introducing Captain Rose[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/710248507efb19ca9117325be862eb00ce0566f3.png[/img]

[h2]Quote[/h2]
"Destroying the World? I've been there..."

[h2]Profession[/h2]
[h3]Captain[/h3]
Fall in line or fall dead.

[h2]Likes[/h2]
???
???
???

[h2]Description[/h2]
[list]
[*] Secure, detached, tough, and observant, Ash's mentor figure and leader of the Loners
[*] The world’s greatest Agro hunter in the time before the Harvest Festival. While that skillset isn’t openly valued today, her living legacy is enough to earn a free drink at any passing bar.
[*]Exposure to *REDACTED* at the heart of the Harvest Festival has left her body brittle and in constant pain. She’s certain that any additional exposure to The Zone could be her last.
[*] Her illness prevents her from returning to The Zone, and her embitterment prevents her from engaging with the Survivors’ Republic. 
[*] She claims not to have any living friends.
[/list]

[h1]Active Skill: Jetbelt[/h1]
[i]When activated, you gain the ability to fly and shoot. While active, you lose a percentage of your maximum Health as damage every second, but this damage cannot down you. Can be canceled at any time.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/8843edd0b9d3bc62352c5cc23a39d575dbf98555.gif[/img]

When using Rose's Active Skill, she equips her Jetbelt, allowing her to Fly through the map! She's capable of freely moving horizontally and vertically while using her Jetbelt. Rose can also use Devices, Shoot, and fire Weapon Skills freely!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/c945a05faf40c198085bfb6058ea7a182fd7d73d.gif[/img]

Once the Jetbelt timer is over, it ends with a literal bang, shooting Rose up in the air for one last mobility burst.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/fff9235cd4d560e5a4c3f8f6c182c4fb05aaefcb.gif[/img]

Just keep in mind that Rose needs to use her own **REDACTED** Power to make her uniquely designed Jetbelt work, so she'll lose a % of her Max Health over time while it is active! 

[h2]Jetbelt Level 2[/h2]
[i]While Jetbelt is active, dealing Bullet Damage generates Charges. When the Charges reach a specific threshold, they are consumed to restore Health.[/i]

Enables Rose to accumulate Bullet Damage done to enemies. Once enough damage has been accumulated, Rose can convert it into Health!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/d11bb8c4423fb9d7f39304488f6705b7b9c600e8.gif[/img]

[h2]Jetbelt Level 3[/h2]
[i]When Jetbelt is activated, it creates an exact copy of your weapon as a Drone. This Drone inherits all your weapon-related Curios and fires simultaneously whenever you shoot.[/i]

Jetbelt is further upgraded and summons a small Drone that copies Rose's current weapon, keeping a copy of every single Curio that affects Weapons as well! The Drone shoots at the same time as Rose and with the same cadence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/1dfd7030d576962027209ba0f684cc0e97a6498f.gif[/img]

[h1]Passive Skill 1: Mature Mastery[/h1]
[i]When falling, if Rose enters Weapon Skill mode, reduces fall speed. Increases all damage done while in the air. [/i]

Whenever Rose is in the air, and enters Aim Mode, she activates her Jetbelt, slowing her fall and making it easier to reach far distances and also giving more time to Shoot enemies while airborne. It also increases Rose's damage every time she's airborne! Be it during her Jetbelt Active Skill, Slowfall, or just by jumping around!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/3c469d4ed871a6309140eec364a8d9ab5a9acbb8.gif[/img]

[h1]Passive Skill 2: Survivor's Guilt[/h1]
[i]Whenever Rose receives healing, she gains one stack of Guilt for each point of health restored. The next time she fires her weapon at an enemy, all Guilt stacks are consumed and added as a percentage-based damage boost. Firing at non-enemy targets does not remove Guilt stacks.[/i]

After the events of the Harvest Festival, Rose has been permanently scarred, giving her PTSD but also empowering her rage whenever combat is tight. Every time Rose is healed, she receives buff Stacks; whenever she shoots her gun, these stacks are consumed and converted into bullet damage. Rose can accumulate unlimited stacks for incredible amounts of damage.

[h1]Passive Skill 3: Every Shot Counts[/h1]
[i]When Rose fires a bullet that consumes all Guilt stacks and defeats an enemy, all Guilt stacks are fully restored.[/i]

A massive upgrade to Survivor's Guilt, Rose can now recover parts of her Guilt Stacks whenever she defeats an enemy after consuming her Guilt Stacks. This improvement can make Rose keep on getting bigger and bigger damage numbers, maybe even becoming capable of killing the strongest of bosses with ONE SHOT.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/3ecff3b8f924b79cee55df238370bd47a9b88961.gif[/img]

Rose is a massive new addition to Atomic Picnic's roster and a special person to some of the other Loners that have already been introduced.

Are you looking forward to playing with Rose? What do you think of her kit? Are you already theory-crafting her builds? Let us know in the comments below and join our [url=discord.gg/atomicpicnic]Discord[/url]

Cheers,
Edu
Atomic Picnic's Creative Director

notes.title: Major Update #1 Preview - Weapon Mods
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Loners!

Now that we've revealed that the first Major Update for Atomic Picnic is coming on February 28th, it's time to take a deep dive into the game's biggest new feature: Weapon Mods.[/h2]

[h1]What are Weapon Mods?[/h1]
Weapon Mods were designed to enable more gameplay styles and better build variety for players. These Mods are modules you can freely swap in and out of your gun while in the camp. They completely change how your weapon works, from how its trigger functions to how many bullets it shoots to making bullets bounce around the environment if you want!

[h1]How do they work?[/h1]
When you open your Weapon Loadout menu, you'll notice a new button that you can press to customize your mods. There are three types of mods: Primary Mods, Reload Mods, and Weapon Skill Mods.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/a8ecb6a4330191f39d842b677bf1ecd644c55467.jpg[/img]
Click the new Modify button to start using your Mods!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/d389d3a4d034ef6cd710624c982ce59e970b4679.jpg[/img]
There will be 3 slots to customize, read about them below!

[h1]Primary Mods[/h1]
Primary Mods change the base behavior of your gun, they can modify bullet damage, fire rate, magazine size, etc... One new mechanic that they are also able to change is the Weapon Skill Fill which increase the rate at which you can use your Weapon Skill!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/a3905b06426f4915a8b58bc9cbbccfb66cc9e173.gif[/img]
When customizing your weapon some might even change their firing pattern!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/033b0f8d67e0271f3fa08da3fe816e732eb6d82a.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/033b0f8d67e0271f3fa08da3fe816e732eb6d82a.gif[/img][/url]
Weapons might change their Shooting Trigger, the Assault Rifle can have a "Charge Time" for increased Fire Rate over time!

But it doesn't stop there. Primary Mods can also change the bullet behavior itself! You can now have a Bubble Shotgun, a Sticky Grenade Launcher, or even a Homing Shot Sniper!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/95c6c22f87952c386ed5bdf4321559784311c34b.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/95c6c22f87952c386ed5bdf4321559784311c34b.gif[/img][/url]
The new Bubble Shotgun is excellent to keep an area safe!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/9b9ce3aa5152251744f65b6480595b0b9553ece5.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/9b9ce3aa5152251744f65b6480595b0b9553ece5.gif[/img][/url]
Sticky Grenades, you shoot a lot of grenades! Great for hordes of enemies!

[h1]Reload Mods[/h1]
Reload Mods change the behavior of your Fast Reload Minigame and provide a small buff for completing it! Buffs can range from increased area size to a small burst of movement speed or infinite ammo for a little bit. There's also a new reload mod that lets you reload twice in a single reload, activating Fast Reload Curios twice! (JD fans REJOICE!)

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/336e2af30bfc1dce5542abce771bb8ed580b9c3c.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/336e2af30bfc1dce5542abce771bb8ed580b9c3c.gif[/img][/url]
Reload can grant you a small movement speed buff for a little bit.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/e4b6e30796d57a27502df0c893eb54b4634b29ae.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/e4b6e30796d57a27502df0c893eb54b4634b29ae.gif[/img][/url]
You can also buff your jump builds if you choose to do so!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/f2be39201523dd7718d410e2a370490141c5772f.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/f2be39201523dd7718d410e2a370490141c5772f.gif[/img][/url]
This one makes JD go crazy. You can activate your fast-reload curios multiple times in a single reload!

[h1]Weapon Skill Mods[/h1]
Here's the real meat of this new system! Weapon Skills is an entirely new mechanic that will be introduced in the first Major Update!

Every weapon will have a Weapon Skill Mod slot; you can equip a variety of different Weapon Skills that each have their own unique functionality, but to use your weapon skill, you need to fill a new gauge located right below your Crosshair. The rate this fills is based on the current Primary Mod, but the quantity needed to fill this gauge and the number of gauges change depending on the Weapon Skill itself!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/17ae51f64d2e1fdb4798b689a2d9b631837bf6d5.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/17ae51f64d2e1fdb4798b689a2d9b631837bf6d5.gif[/img][/url]
Fill your Weapon Skill Gauge by shooting enemies!

So now that you have filled some gauges, it's time to use your Weapon Skill! You just now need to Aim your gun and then shoot! This will consume your Weapon Skill Gauge and shoot your Weapon Skill!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/b7870e1eb4831492b3167cc2abc90f0c62f845de.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/b7870e1eb4831492b3167cc2abc90f0c62f845de.gif[/img][/url]
The new Lightning Orb Weapon Skill shocks enemies around it, but if you fire at the Lightning Orb itself, you can boost its output like crazy!

[h3]Important: all Weapon Mods will be unlocked from the start when the update is released so everyone can try them out! But we'll soon lock them behind Discoveries for you to unlock them as you play :)[/h3]

There's more to come during this update and more mods we haven't even shown!

What do you think? Please leave a like and comment below to tell us what you want to see!


Cheers,
Edu
Atomic Picnic's Creative Director

notes.title: Update #5 - Gold, Fire, and HUD - v0.5.7
notes.content:
As our first Major update begins internal testing, [b]Atomic Picnic v0.5.7[/b] brings fresh [b]visual upgrades, UI improvements, and a new Fire Path so you can burn them all.[/b]

From the [b]final model of the elusive Gold Goblin[/b] to the revamped [b]Curios HUD and fiery new VFX[/b], every battle is looking sharper. Plus, we’re rolling out smoother [b]combat text, more precise evolutions display[/b], and a fresh state indicator for [b]JD’s Active Skill[/b] - because every second counts when survival is on the line.

As usual, we’ve also tackled [b]bugs and community-requested fixes[/b], making progression and loadout management smoother. And while we’re still hunting down a few pesky issues (we see you, flying Ash 👀), this fast update is all about making every run [b]more thrilling, responsive, and satisfying[/b].

Let’s jump into the details:

[h3]What’s New?[/h3]

[b]Enhanced Visuals & UI Tweaks[/b]
[list]
[*] Gold Goblin now has its final model—may the drip be with you!

[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/3039a42f15cad17a2e68fd8de9771d7681e7ca18.png[/img]
[list]

[*] [b]Grenade Launcher[/b] VFX colors adjusted for better clarity.
[*] New [b]Fire Path VFX[/b]—because destruction should look as good as it feels.

[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/8158601733dad2a0e6017eb7f2f8eed4584cdaa3.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Event announcements[/b] now include [b]illustrations[/b] for more clarification.
[*] This is direct feedback from those confused about what each announcement meant!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/d2ce0d27105a25e6ede093b627555e7ba4f3e273.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Combat text[/b] is smaller and blends better with the action.
[list]
[*] This makes combat a much cleaner experience; let us know what you think!
[/list][*] [b]Curios HUD (top left corner) revamped[/b] for a sleeker experience.
[list]
[*] [b]Shop items & Cursed Curios[/b] no longer clutter the UI.
[*] You can see at a glance which level each Curio is now.
[*] [b]Evolutions[/b] are now displayed [b]instead of individual curios[/b] used in their recipe. Giving them the highlight that they deserve.
[*] [b]The 8-curio limit is now properly displayed[/b] in the HUD.
[/list]

notes.title: Update #3 - Banish Curios, Purify Curses, and new fixes!! - v0.5.5
notes.content:
First of all, Happy 2025 Loners!

This update introduces exciting new features to enhance your adventure! Enjoy a [b]revamped Objectives UI[/b] and two brand-new [b]Mementos[/b] [i](Cosmic Fragrance and Infinite Trash)[/i], which add fresh layers of strategy to your gameplay. 

We’ve also introduced [b]visual upgrades[/b], including polished drop effects and new banners for interactable objects. Plus, category icons have been redesigned for easier navigation, and performance optimizations ensure smoother gameplay for hosts and players alike.

And as some of you Loners requested, you can now [b]skip the Special Chest Animation![/b]

[/list]
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/4155da734353e6d6b5596e9dc2d3910163826b76.gif[/img]

[list]

Keep in mind you can't banish Curios that you've already obtained. If you banish a cursed curio, that exact combination of effects won't show in your current run again!
[/list]
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/fd77a561762a037788e4fd1a7a6e921c0e145989.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Category Icons:[/b] Redesigned for easier navigation (Discoveries, Mementos, Loadout, Start Picnic).

[list]

[/list][/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Special Chest Skip:[/b][list]
[*] Only the host can skip, with a fast-forward button, to finish the animation quickly.
[/list][/list][list][*] VFX optimizations for [i]Icy Orbs[/i].
[*] Curio UIs now display "MAX" instead of "LVL 4" when maxed on every screen.
[*] Removed Christmas decorations from the camp. It's time to welcome the new year!
[/list]

[list]

[*] Buff stacks no longer break lines when exceeding 99 (below health).
[/list]
[h3]Known Issues
[/h3][list]
[*] The game starts stuttering during the transition to the Final Boss stage
[*] The game starts stuttering, freezes, and clients are disconnected
[*] Opening Taka-chan and then instantly leveling up might cause the Taka-chan screen to freeze
[*] Music starts stuttering and stops playing until the game crashes or the user returns to Camp in co-op
[*] Dead ally might be invisible to other players

[*] Ash's Ultimate and Gear Dash Combo Allows Unintended High-Flying Out of the Playable Area

[h3]Director's Commentary[/h3]
Hey everyone! Thank you so much for all your comments, feedback, critiques, and suggestions. A special shout-out goes to ruff1298 in our Steam Discussion forum; bro's been cooking a lot. While we're preparing our first major update, addressing the most significant player's pain points is still essential. We're currently looking at changes related to the first map's difficulty and improving the Discovery System to allow for a much better progression and unlock flow. This will be a lot of work and take some time, but we hear you and want to make it right <3.

Please keep sending your feedback; this is the only way we can make Atomic the best game it can be 😊 . As always, I'll be on the Steam Discussion forum answering you guys, or you can ping me on our Discord and send your feedback there!

Cheers!
[I]-[Dev] Ashkental[/i]

notes.title: Update #2 - New Curios, Combat Experience and More! - v0.5.4
notes.content:
To celebrate the end of the year, we prepared a new update with new Curios, a new night mode map, and quality of life improvements!

And... a holiday splash art for you Loners to [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/18UclHHCkJjjIjPZs3TWSBunKvBHYbxgM?usp=sharing]download[/url]. 😁

We've been reading all your comments and took time to revamp a significant part of the Combat Experience by changing how enemies despawn and completely remaking the Snakes (and other Shooters!) and its AI Behavior!

This update should boost multiplayer performance as well! So, if you were having networking issues, please try again and let us know!

[h3]What's New?
[/h3][b]Curios:[/b]
[list]
[*][b] Alternate Actuality:[/b] Defeating an enemy has a chance of spawning Snowbro, who'll inflict stacks of Chill on your Enemies! Gear Dashing through Snowbro will cause it to explode and deal tons of Chill!
[/list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/5239960e5bfde11c9d968a988d0f5f3ea40140d6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/bda118cfe330454b6e5ca46c58ba58963a3509cf.png[/img][/url][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/d0c38af9b42dd9b8be7d252ad3f0b17e10c8f9ad.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Scoopert:[/b] While your Device is on Cooldown, it spawns Orbs around you that apply stacks of Chill to enemies. Shooting these Orbs applies even more stacks!
[/list][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/1d3d310b9e4fe6ac47cf7acdb4ef4e9dc12e12e2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/e390b5f3189402b994346276e2a844d57167801c.png[/img][/url][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/2c29a83fa1273d93b767aff5cdffd410961abc01.gif[/img]

[b]New Night Mode Map:
[/b][list]
[*] [b]Twilight Dam:[/b] An ancient structure used to generate energy from way before Core splitting was a thing... A reality break envelops this area on permanent Twilight.
[/list]

[b]Director Note:
[/b][i]The [b]Night Mode[/b] version of Twilight Dam should introduce a new challenge for those Loners who are incredibly experienced. If you manage to beat it, let us know![/i]

[b]Visual Enhancements:
[/b][b]A snow-kissed Loner's Camp:
[/b][list]
[*] The Loner's Camp gets a holiday makeover:
[*] Snow-covered landscapes and frozen water.
[*] Twinkling Christmas lights.
[*] A glowing Christmas tree.
[*] And yes, even Rose is rocking a Santa hat.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/5f51896ab1569f5b45b8bdbb9970757f215961a1.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/e22315178f5bb0f15f55c129901e74a2cb3dd0df.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/b21d199566a985f0122cded21aaba5909b19e711.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Goop VFX revamped! Now, it’s yellow for better understanding and visibility.
[list] [*] [i]This is part of our quest to improve readability and better teach Camille's fight. This should make the Goop less fearsome for some players who mistook it for a "Poisonous" field.[/i] [/list]
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/88b1278757e6fb3c89d60754b65db9af948ae5ac.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Enhanced lighting on characters, weapons, and devices in the loadout screen—looking sharp!
[*] Sleek new outlines for characters, enemies, and props.
[/list]
[h3]Quality of Life Upgrades
[/h3][list][*][b]Locked Content Preview:[/b]
[list]
[*] Content that players have yet to unlock appears in the mysterious atomic font... 👀[/list]
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/d68d3042c03b45e8b2d10b266e3d7bb927bef61e.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Visible discoveries display unlock progress for better tracking.
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]Interactions: Hold E action is now instant for most in-picnic actions.[/b]
[list]
[*] Selecting Offerings, Buying Items, Activating Events, and Opening Taka-Chan are examples of now instant interactions.
[*] Reviving Players is still a press-and-hold action.
[*] All Camp actions are still press-and-hold. 
[/list]
[/list][h3]Changes & Balancing
[/h3][list]
[*] [b]Discovery System Rebalanced:[/b]
[list]
[*] Most Discoveries are now easier to unlock 
[*] Some Discoveries now offer higher currency rewards.
[*] Previously unlocked content will still be available, even if the discovery disappears and it's locked. [i]Don't be surprised! Players will receive unlocked notifications again, even if the item has already been unlocked.[/i]
[/list]
[/list][list][*] [b]Enemy AI Tweaks:[/b]
[list]
[*] Enemies will not easily despawn anymore.
[*] Enemies will now spawn much further away from you.
[*] Snacks will now try its best to teleport in front of the player they are targeting.
[*] Snacks now teleport further away from the player.
[*] Shooter enemies AI rebalanced to be less frustrating when attacking players from behind.
[/list]
[/list][list]
[*] XP drop VFX intensity toned down—less flash, same reward!
[*] [b]Slippery Surfaces:[/b] Light poles just got trickier. Testing this feature for future hazard zones.
[/list]
Director Note:
[i]Although they seem small, these combat changes are extremely significant. We've noticed the game is much more manageable, especially when doing Events, Objectives, or when fighting against lots of enemies. Enemies not despawning and spawning much further away means you can see them and better prepare yourself for the fight, while they won't just randomly pop right in your face all the time. This is part of our ongoing efforts to make combat in Atomic Picnic feel amazing, so let us know what you think. This change could only happen due to your feedback on our Steam Forums and Discord!
[/i]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Snake Enemy:[/b]
[list] [*] Fixed Elite Snake's bouncing bullet VFX[/list]
[*] [b]Camille Teleport:[/b]
[list] [*] Lag spikes during boss fights? Not anymore. Performance and connection issues resolved.[/list]
[*] [b]Enemy Spawn Stability:[/b]
[list][*] No more random despawning. Enemies are here to stay until defeated.
[list] [*] [b]This fix should mitigate disconnection issues[/b].[/list] [/list]
[*] [b]Explodable Bouncing Bullets:[/b]
[list] [*] Fixed multiple explosions, missing explosions, and odd behavior on irregular surfaces.[/list]
[*] [b]Peace Time Spawns:[/b]
[list] [*] Fixed enemies who were rudely interrupting your downtime.[/list]
[*] [b]Performance Tweaks:[/b]
[list] [*] Bullet data optimizations that should decrease network traffic.
[*] Optimizations for enemy jump VFX.
[*] Fixed leaking event data from incomplete events that were causing performance and networking overhead.[/list] 
[*] [b]Camille Fixes:[/b]
[list] [*] Corrected oversized hitbox, expanding ball of bullets attack position, bullet size, and compatibility with the Suspicious Mirror (Curio) and JD's Active Skill.[/list]
[*] [b]Other Fixes[/b]
[*] Fixed Taka-chan not responding when opening it simultaneously when the Mini-Boss spawns.
[*] Fixed Camp UI disappearing (We fixed it, but we are still testing this! So help us if you see that happening!)
[*] Fixed Enemies getting stuck on a rock shelf in Train Plateau.
[*] AI Pathfinding Update
[list] [*] Fewer places where enemies are spawning inside walls.
[*] Enemies jump loop should not happen anymore.
[list] [*] Sometimes, enemies kept jumping in the same place without getting closer to the player.[/list][*] Enemies navigation mesh is more straightforward and should demand less from weaker machines when hosting.
[*] Melee enemies slightly shake when reaching the player's closest position on NavMesh.
[*] Improved Little Mac's AI to better focus on one player at a time.[/list]
[/list][h3]Known Issues
[/h3][list]
[*] Dead allies might be invisible to other players.
[*] Inviting through Steam sometimes makes friends join random people.
[*] Safeguard, while downed, blocks the user from continuing playing.
[*] The game starts stuttering during the transition to the Final Boss stage.
[*] Ash's Active Skill and Gear Dash combo allows unintended high-flying out of the playable area. (This is why we can't have nice things 🤣)
[*] Placeholder Cubes are being used as Debuff Indicators in Bonnie's Drop Lvl 3 skill.
[*] Incorrect Prompt for Curios Screen: "TouchPad" is shown instead of "Share" on the PS5 Controller.
[*] [b]There are still some connection issues happening, we will continue investigating them.[/b]
[/list]
[h3]Happy Holidays!
[/h3]This is more than just an update. It’s a thank [b]YOU[/b] from us! Most of the impactful changes we've made here were thanks to your feedback, reports, and suggestions. Please keep them coming so we can make Atomic Picnic the best game it can be 💖

Have fun with the new content, improved combat experience, and a snow-kissed Loner's Camp! Whether you're here to build the best Chill Build or soak in the holiday vibes, this update is for you.
Bundle up, grab your Snowbro, and make this holiday one to remember! See you in-game!

Happy Holidays from the BitCake Team

PS: We will take our break from [b]Dec 20 to Jan 6[/b], but we're already cooking stuff for next year. Stay tuned!

[*] Icon Updates: Some discovery icons have been replaced with updated versions.
[*] Discovery Rewards Tweak: Pebble rewards no longer trigger a fanfare.
[*] Level-Up Screen Simplification: Stats for regular curios are no longer shown, focusing only on Cursed Curios.
[list]
[*] [i]The reason we're hiding this information for now is because the way we had it displayed was causing a lot of confusion for players. When players read that a Curio Level Up gained +2% Probability, they thought that this stat applied to their entire character and not to that Curio only. So, we decided to remove these stats change display for now while we think of a better way of communicating that. This is a temporary change while we find better solutions! So thank you for your understanding[/i] 🙏
[/list]
[*] Balancing Adjustments:
[list]
[*] Slight buffs and tweaks for upgrades with underwhelming evolutions.
[*] Sniper now shoots faster for a smoother experience.
[*] Gold Goblin drops an XP Vacuum reward when escaping with low health.
[*] Players can now be revived from greater heights.
[*] Chest rewards now vary in probability, with a smaller chance for one-reward chests and better odds for three-reward chests.
[*] Night mode bosses got a health boost and only drop cores now, no regular XP.
[/list][/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list][*] Gameplay:[list]
[*] Gold Goblin now only drops Pebbles after activation.

[/list][*] End Game Screen:
[list][*] "Send Us Feedback" can now be closed with the gamepad.(Sorry about that gamepad people!)
[/list][list] [*] Holding "Continue" no longer affects the "Send Us Feedback" button.
[*] Corrected level display issues.[/list][*] Tutorial: Fixed "Skip Tutorial" button for clients after completion or skipping.

[/list]
[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] Some discovery trackers (e.g., deposits, devices) are not working as expected.
[*] Certain enemies might get stuck during Peace Time.
[*] Unit spawns and movement are glitchy on Train Plateau.
[*] Dead allies may appear invisible to teammates.
[*] Inviting friends through Steam may result in joining random lobbies.
[*] Players with Safeguard, while downed, may encounter gameplay blockage.
[*] Taka-chan is unresponsive if opened simultaneously with a Mini-Boss spawn.
[/list]
[h2]Snacks Combat Behavior
[/h2]As I've said before, we've been reading all comments, and this is BY FAR the biggest pain point still in the game. Unfortunately, we haven't addressed it in this update. Still, we are working on improving the Snacks combat so it doesn't feel cheap and frustrating, especially their Teleporting near you and Shooting behind you. We're prototyping some solutions and iterating, this takes a bit more time to do and we want to do it properly, but at the same time I feel we should address this directly so you know what to expect. Again, thank you all for your patience regarding this! 🙏

We're super excited to be receiving so much feedback from the community, and we want to make Atomic the best game we can, so please keep sending your comments, suggestions, bug reports, and more! And if you want to reach me, you can do so in the Forums or Discord, which is where I hang out the most <3

Stay tuned for our following updates because we're cooking!

See you in the Picnic,

notes.title: Atomic Picnic’s Early Access Content Roadmap
notes.content:
[h2]Hey everyone, Edu here, Creative Director of Atomic Picnic![/h2]

First of all, thank you so much for the amazing support you've been giving us during our Early Access launch! 

The Team and I have been down in the trenches answering our community on the Forums (yes, it's really me there), reading your reviews, watching Twitch streams and YouTube videos, and collecting every single piece of feedback you've given us. There's a lot of stuff to talk about, so let's do it! 

[h3]Priority Fixes[/h3]
Here's a list of most pressing fixes that we've identified and are working to fix ASAP (or have already fixed by the time you read this heheh):
[list] [*] Networking issues [list] [*] We've already released a Hotfix addressing the most pressing Networking issues we found, but there are more fixes to come to improve stability even further. [/list] [*] Crashes [list] [*] We've already identified and fixed some crashing issues and we'll be working with you guys to fix even more! [/list] [*] Improved AI behavior [list] [*] Some enemies were behaving poorly and we already released a hotfix to address that, but we've received a lot of feedback in regards to enemies like Little Mac and Snacks and we'll be exploring ways to make their AI Behavior better (and fairer). [/list] [*] Balancing [list] [*] There are some balancing issues currently in the game that we want to resolve. Unfortunately that means Hani is in our sights. Although our internal philosophy is to balance everything upwards and OP, we fear that we might have gone a bit too far with him. We'll also be taking a look at weapons, curios and other abilities that might be feeling a bit underpowered right now. [/list] [*] UI [list] [*] There's a lot of things we can improve in our current UI so we're exploring some options here, especially to make our Discovery Screen a lot more readable and understandable. We'll be doing a bit more to explain how some mechanics work. [/list] [/list]
[h3]Features we hear you want[/h3]
You've been telling us all your wishes, so we're compiling here what has been most requested from you guys. We're listening!
[list] [*] Matchmaking / Server Browser / Quickplay* [*] More Build Diversity [*] More ways to Customize your Playstyle [*] More Characters [*] Better and more interesting Discoveries [/list] [i]* This feature is something that we can't confirm will come to the game. We're investigating options in regards to forms of matching players so they play together inside the game itself.[/i]

Check out the full roadmap of future content at the bottom of this post! 

Oh, if you want to help shape the future development of the game, you can reach us on our Discord server. 

[h3]Christmas is Coming![/h3]
Atomic will be celebrating with a new update! It will have a new night map, a couple new curios and snow!

notes.content:
We’ve issued a new hotfixe for Atomic Picnic today.  We hear your feedback and are working hard to fix issues and improve your gameplay experience.

[*] Characters discoveries all rebalanced, so that it's faster to unlock them  [list] [*] JD: 1000 > 200 active reload [*] Hani: 12.000 > 6.000 receive damage [*] Bonnie: 80 > 50 dodges [/list] [/list] [b]Fixes:[/b]

notes.content:
[h1]It's time! Atomic Picnic officially drops into Early Access on November 7—but if you're itching to jump in right now, we’ve got you covered![/h1]

The [b]final public playtest[/b] has just kicked off and will run for the next [b]7 days.[/b] This is your last shot to try out new features, objectives, and wild Curios before launch. Plus, we need your help to test and perfect everything before the big day!

[b]You’ll need to unlock a few characters and weapons this time around. Keep in mind that not all characters and weapons from previous playtests will be available at this time.[/b] But you’ll also find plenty of new goodies to experiment with. Please also note that any progress in this playtest will re-set and wipe before launch. 

So, let’s get into what’s new in [b]v0.4.8[/b]:

[b]What’s New:[/b]
[list] [*] [b]Cursed Curios[/b]: A fresh batch of Curios that change your attributes permanently—both good and bad. High risk, high reward! 
[*] [b]New Curios[/b]: [/*] [list] [*] One-Eyed Whirli: Spawns twisters that push enemies away. [/*] [*] [b]Brisk Enkindlement[/b]: Chills nearby enemies. [/*] [*] [b]Firebranded Whisk[/b]: Leave a burning trail when using Air Gear. [/*] [/list] [*] [b]New Evolutions[/b] [*] [b]New Objectives & Events[/b]: Missions to shake up your Picnics! [*] Aura Pillars, Gold Goblin, and Area Hold Explosive challenges. [*] [b]New Drop Chest[/b]: Defeat Minibosses or complete events to score Evolutions, Pebbles, Curios, or shop items. [/list]
[b]New Systems & Changes:[/b]
[list] [*] [b]Curio Limit[/b]: You can now equip up to 8 different Curios. Cursed and Evolution Curios don’t count toward this limit! [*] [b]New Memento[/b]: Unlock the [b]Frictionless D20[/b] (Reroll) by earning it—no more freebie on the level-up screen. [/list]
[b]Visual Improvements:[/b]
[list] [*] Updated visuals for various locations inside the [b]Loner’s Camp[/b]. [/*] [*] Character idle animations are smoother. [/*] [*] [b]Ash[/b] now has dynamic equipment loadout animations. [/*] [*] A reworked [b]Toon Shader[/b] and better antialiasing for a cleaner look. [/*] [*][b]New Water Shader[/b] and improved terrain materials. [/*] [/list]
[b]Quality of Life Upgrades:[/b]
[list] [*] [b]Single Player Pause[/b] is finally here—take a breather whenever you need. [/*] [*] Improved rendering performance, better object culling, and [b]shadow quality[/b]. [/*] [*] [b]Partial Localization[/b] and [b]Controller Support[/b] improvements. [/*] [*] Optimized for wider aspect ratios (16:10 and 21:9), the game looks crisp no matter your screen. [/*] [*] New [b]Loading Screens[/b] with tips and tricks. [/*] [*] Sound upgrades, including a vocal boss-fight track and enhanced SFX for key moments.[/*] [/list]
[b]Gameplay Tweaks & Balancing:[/b]
[list] [*] [b]Harder Difficulty[/b]: We’ve cranked up the challenge. Think you can handle it? [/*] [*] [b]Discovery System[/b]: It now takes more playtime to complete, but the rewards are even better. [/*] [*] [b]Octavio Boss Rework[/b]: Now packs an even bigger punch! [/*] [*]Improved enemy targeting and flying enemies that mix up their altitude for a more dynamic challenge. [/*] [/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list] [*] Fixed game freezes during objectives.
[*] Corrected issues where certain enemies weren’t taking damage from some Curios.
[*] Resolved problems with [b]UI flickering[/b] and made various improvements to [b]controller navigation[/b].
[*] Fixed [b]connection errors[/b] in some regions and addressed minor glitches to smooth your experience [/list]

[list] [*] VFX for new Curios may persist when a character is downed.
[*] Some projectiles don’t disappear properly.
[*] Certain rewards for Discoveries aren’t showing the correct icons.
[*] We're still squashing various minor bugs with 3D models, endgame screens, and more. [/list]

That’s it for now! Thanks for joining us in this playtest and helping us make Atomic Picnic the best. We can’t wait to see what chaos you create with all these new Curios, Evolutions, and missions!

notes.title: Atomic Picnic Launches November 7 + Final Public Playtest Now Live!
notes.content:
[h1]Heads up, Loners, we have big news!  Atomic Picnic will launch in Steam Early Access on Thursday November 7 at a price of $19.99(USD)![/h1]

[previewyoutube=J24MUQQM6xI;full][/previewyoutube]

And that’s not all - we’ve just kicked off our FINAL public playtest. Hit “Request Access” on the Steam page now to get right in. Here’s the new stuff we’re testing out this week: 
[list]
[*] [b]New “Cursed Curios”[/b]: These new types of Curios are both buff and bane!
[*] [b]New standard Curios and Evolutions[/b]: More ways to build out your character and combine Curios. 
[*] [b]In-game Events and Objectives[/b]: More things to do in a Picnic, like taking out Pillars and chasing down Gold Goblins. 
[*] Plus new Mementos, localizations, visual improvements, UI elements, and sound effects!
[/list]
For full details and patch notes on this playtest, LINKhead to this post all about itLINK. The playtest will run for one week, ending on October 17th. 

[b]Back to the big news - launch on Nov 7th! [/b] Here’s what to expect when Atomic Picnic hits Early Access:

[list]
[*] [b]Four Hungry Loners[/b]: Ash, Hani, Bonnie, and JD are ready to Picnic! Each Loner boasts unique stats and abilities, allowing for varying playstyles. Try each out and find which suits you! Permanently upgrade character stats via Mementos, which are acquired through Discoveries as Loners complete Picnics.
[*] [b]Mementos and Discoveries[/b]: Loners will scour maps for valuable resources that unlock 18 different Mementos: character and gear upgrades for future runs. Completing specific challenges within Picnics will reveal Discoveries, which in turn grant new Mementos, characters, and weapons.
[*] [b]Three Maps to Picnic On[/b]: [/*] [list] [*] Train Plateau: Set up your Picnic in an abandoned trainyard, ripe for resource scavenging. If you’re lucky, you might find something worth cold cash! You can also come back to the Plateau in night mode, facing off against a different set of even tougher enemies. [/*] [*] Twilight Dam: What cataclysmic event ravaged this dam? Picnic here to explore this mysteriously wrecked rift, in day or night mode! [/*] [*] City of Sand: Two dimensions, one city. Explore and Picnic in a glorious city caught within the sands of time…or what’s left of it. [/*] [/list]
[*] [b]Curious About Curios[/b]: In-run upgrades known as Curios represent the dramatic changes a Loner’s build will go through as they progress a Picnic. [/*] [list] [*] Standard Curios unleash your Loner’s full potential as its stats and abilities dynamically adapt to every acquired Curios. [/*] [*] Cursed Curios offer additional boosts but come with a trade-off, potentially lowering other stats! [/*] [*] Evolved Curios, created by combining standard Curios, represent the pinnacle for a character’s build and provide unparalleled power. [/list]
[*] [b]Floating on Air[/b]: Loners need to be mobile in the wasteland to survive - and they have Impulse Gear to fling, dash, and swing at breakneck speed around each map. Use Air Gear to move in the air, and Gear Dash to speed along the ground. 
[*] [b]Picnic Objectives[/b]: Within a Picnic run, Loners will tackle a variety of objectives—from defeating a set number of enemies to toppling specific bosses and destroying pillars in different parts of the map. Each Picnic hosts its own set of challenges for players to accomplish in order to progress the run and make it home alive. 
[*] [b]Wasteland Weaponry[/b]: Pick your poison: five traditional weapons –  an assault rifle, shotgun, grenade launcher, sniper rifle, and pistol – are at your disposal. Tear down the crowd with these firearms, or blast ‘em to bits with four unique grenades!
[*] [b]Enemies Galore[/b]: In the wasteland, terrors lie in wait for unsuspecting Loners. Face off against 11 distinct enemy types, and when you’ve conquered them, take on three minibosses to gear up for the final showdown with two massive and fearsome end-run bosses.
[/list]
We hope you’ll jump into our playlist, and become Loners with us when we launch in November!  Please keep the feedback coming here on Steam and in the [url=www.discord.gg/atomicpicnic]Discord[/url]. 

Oh and don’t forget - we’re giving away an awesome Starforge Systems gaming PC with a custom art case at launch. Join the community at [url=OTK.to/AP]OTK.to/AP[/url] to enter to win!

notes.content:
Attention Loners, we have an important update to share:  Atomic Picnic will no longer launch into Early Access in September. The game will launch later in 2024. 

Simply put, we need a bit more time to make sure the game meets your expectations, and ours. We’ll use this time to finish developing some new systems, fine-tuning things, and polishing the title.

As soon as we have a new date to share, we’ll let you know here and in the Discord. We may even have one last playtest opportunity for you all. Please stay tuned for more, and thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: New playtest & Early Access launch this September!
notes.content:
[b]Hey Loners![/b] We have big news to share.  If you tuned in to the OTK Expo today you may have already heard: [b]Atomic Picnic will hit Early Access this September. [/b]

But that’s not all, [b]we are kicking off a new playtest right now[/b].  If you’ve playtested the title before, you have access here on Steam and can jump right in.  If you haven’t yet, head over to [url=OTK.to/AP]OTK.to/AP[/url] to join the community and get your Steam key. 

The feedback that you’ve given us in the last playtests has had a major impact on our development.  Check out a new trailer with some of what's new, and then read on for all the details: 

[previewyoutube=ZixwTCXjqAY;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] New weapon: the powerful Pistol!
[*] New Mini-boss: Jonathan, a Turtle mini-boss that can be found in the Twilight Dam map. 
[*] New Enemies: Flying Shooter that sprays a pattern of shots, and JellyEgg who spawns several Mini Jelly.
[*] New Upgrade (Curio): Doom on Device, adds a Doom effect on the enemies that are hit by your device. 
[*] New character skills: Both active and passive skills (more details below)!
[*] New character base statistics: Each character now has 4 different base stats. 
[*] New device models: Your grenades have new looks.
[*] Hidden OTK influencer tags
[/list]
You read that right, [b]each character now has their own abilities[/b]. More info on each:

Active abilities, activated by pressing the ‘Q’ key:
[list]
[*] Hani / Handyman: Hani charges his hammer and smashes it on the ground, damaging enemies and healing teammates. He can charge the hammer for up to 3 seconds, the longer the charge and more damage taken while charging, the more damage and healing he does. 
[*] JD / Tacticbot: JD summons a flying drone that follows him around and shoots enemies.
[*] Bonnie / Dive Bomb: Bonnie jumps into the air and lands with an impact that deals damage in an area around her. 
[*] Ash / Dash Bomb: Ash dashes through the air, ending with an explosion that deals damage to nearby enemies. 
[/list]
Passive abilities, always affecting individual characters:
[list]
[*] Hani / Closer: Hani does more damage per each nearby enemy, up to 20% more damage.
[*] JD / Multitap - When JD throws a Device, he causes all Fast Reloads Curios to activate automatically. 
[*] Bonnie / Headbutt - When Gear Dashing or Super Jumping through enemies, Bonnie deals damage and applies the Concussion debuff. Concussion slows enemies.
[*] Ash / Scout: Ash has one extra Air Gear charge.
[/list]
These Passive Skills are now affected by Mementos too:
[list]
[*] Hani Passive Skill is now affect by Area Size
[*] Bonnie Passive Skill is now affected by Cooldown and Damage
[*] JD Passive Skill is now affected by Cooldown
[/list]
[b]New UX / UI Elements & Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] New screen: Start a Picnic
[*] A new map selection screen to check which maps you have unlocked or not (still with placeholder graphics)
[*] New UI background 
[*] Animated background in all screens 
[*] New game flow: Removed main menu
[*] New Esc menu
[*] New social tab with Steam friend list display
[*] Now players can join others when already inside their own Camp
[*] Now if the player is solo on a hosted Camp the game will auto change to single-player mode (no connection needed) during a Picnic
[*] New Discoveries screen unlock animations 
[/list]
[b]New Audio: [/b]
[list]
[*] Healing Shrine SFX
[*] Offerings SFX
[*] Loner's Camp OST
[/list]
[b]Balancing & Other Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Overall rebalancing to make game harder
[*] Harder mini-bosses
[*] Harder enemies
[*] Rebalanced time needed to revive others
[*] Weapons fast reload thresholds balancing
[*] New XP curve
[*] Rebalanced Mementos 
[*] New Berserker VFX
[*] Controller Support now working for Social screen, and Start Picnic screen 
[*] Teddybear and some other AoE Curios now break destructible items
[*] Added a delay after the players complete a Picnic (kill the final boss), so they have time to collect the loot before the End Game screen shows up
[*] New camera configuration for all characters
[*] New animation for Map selection screen
[*] Increased Air Gear invulnerability, or iFrames time
[*] Changed the active abilities UI (Devices, Air Gear, Active Skills) to fit the new Active Skills button 
[*] Changed the Discoveries screen to allow for more Discoveries on the same screen, and fill the whole screen area 
[*] Restricting Steam join to only when inside Camp
[*] Performance changes in Loner's Camp scene related to shadows
[*] Rework on enemy despawn system to deprioritize enemies that are not actively engaging in combat, and are not being seen by players
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Rework on Jellyfish shield code that fixes some Curios that bypassed Octavio’s shield
[*] MiniJelly base stats fixed
[*] Ricochet ability now working properly
[*] Changed Memento title instead of Curio in the Tab screen in-game
[*] Rojo device area preview size is now the same as its collider
[*] Ghost story now dealing damage to all enemies
[*] First upgrade no longer automatically selected when using a mouse in the Level Up screen 
[*] Peace Time title now showing up when a boss is killed 
[*] All maps no longer use the same enemy configuration
[*] In the in-game HUD, in the Objectives widget, the Jelly Fish boss's name is now correct (Octavio)
[/list]
As you can see, there’s a ton of new stuff to check out in this playtest. But heads up on some known issues as well…

[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] Some buttons have localization for gamepad support, and the strings go beyond the intended area
[*] Active Reloads and other gameplay mechanics used in the Camp should not count towards the Discoveries
[*] Some new upgrades still don't have detail stats in the Level Up screen (the lower text with stat changes)
[*] In the Twilight Dam map, the collision in the Dam area can cause the player to not move properly
[*] Discovery "Starting with the basics": Tracking each enemy defeat multiple times on clients
[*] "Peace time" text does not show up properly after a boss is defeated. 
[*] Hani's active skill can have an animation glitch if used right when the character levels up
[*] Ping icons are not disappearing, and will accumulate in the map
[*] Some projectiles VFX do not disappear
[*] MiniJelly and JellyEgg are not being damaged by some curios
[/list]
Get to testing, and let us know what you think here on Steam and in [url=www.discord.gg/atomicpicnic]the Discord[/url]!
