notes.title: Playtest Atomic Picnic April 10-17!
notes.content:
Hello Loners!  We’re running our next public playtest of Atomic Picnic next week, April 10-17. 

You can get in to the test starting Wednesday, April 10, by joining our community at [url=http://OTK.to/AP]OTK.to/AP[/url]. On Friday, April 13, it will open up to everyone right on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1903560/Atomic_Picnic/]Steam page[/url]. You can play through the 17th, we’ll turn things off first thing on the morning of the 18th. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/0d136b4f4b0e53f74ea03334f065a2d26f0ff001.png[/img]
Here’s a breakdown of everything new in this playtest: 
[list]
[*] [b]The Loner’s Camp:[/b] A new hub and lobby where you can pick your character and loadout, and get some practice on the firing range and platforming course. 

[*] [b]A new map:[/b] Twilight Dan is our second map, tighter and more frenetic than the first. 

[*] [b]Discoveries & progression system:[/b] You’ll start this playtest with one character, one weapon, and one device. Unlock more via challenges we’ve dubbed “Discoveries”. 

[*] [b]New mini-boss and enemy:[/b] Our new mini-boss, “Wilson”, and new enemy mobs known as “Berserkers” can be encountered on both maps. 

[*] [b]Seven new upgrades:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Bible - Bring down an orbital strike surrounding your character.
[*] Static Dash - Use of Air Gear charges up the damage of your next attack.
[*] Empowered Shot - Boost bullet damage on successful active reload. 
[*] Shockwave - Area of effect damage on landing after using Air Gear
[*] Dash Shot - Fire a bullet when using Air Gear to dash. 
[*] Projectile Pattern on Device - Alters the pattern of your device’s impact.
[*] Absorb - Damage taken while using Air Gear heals your character. 
[/olist]
[*] [b]Assorted fixes and optimizations:[/b] Bugs squashed, graphics optimizations, UI tweaks, an upgrade re-roll feature, and much more.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/c1a15ac6f98e56b4a9bae412deaa5ccb2b63a737.png[/img]
Your feedback is super helpful as we continue to work on the game. After you play, please hit us up on [url=http://www.discord.gg/atomicpicnic]Discord[/url] to tell us what you think. 

[b]Thank you, and see you in the Wasteland![/b]

notes.title: New Update is Live! Little Mac Remake, AMD Crash Fix and more!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, let us start by saying the AMD Crash should be fixed now! Sorry it took us this long!

On other news, there's some new juicy stuff on this update like Inverted Y and X options, separate Volume Knobs and a new Upgrade: Walkpod!

[h1]Features[/h1]
[h2]New Little Mac[/h2]
[list]
[*] Little Mac has spent some time training and came back with new attacks and abilities!
[/list]
[h2]New Upgrade: Walkpod[/h2]
[list]
[*] Every time you Fast Reload your weapon, summon a Sound Pulse to damage enemies all around you!
[/list]
[h2]Improved Progression[/h2]
[list]
[*] We took a hard look into how the game was played and we made some improvements to overall match time and wave balancing. Both Bosses should appear much faster and match times should be reduced by a bit!
[*] Increased XP Gain during matches
[/list]
[h2]AMD Crash Fix[/h2]
[list]
[*] Sorry it took us this long, but the game should now be playable on older AMD Cards!
[/list]
[h2]Invert Y and X Axis![/h2]
[list]
[*] For those of you who couldn't play the game before due to this missing option, now you can properly play the game!
[/list]
[h2]Separate Volumes[/h2]
[list]
[*] We've separated Ambience, Music and SFX Volumes so you can have better control of those while playing!
[/list]

[h1]Director's Commentary[/h1]
Let me start by saying that I'm sorry it took us this long to fix the Crash that was affecting some of you guys. I'm sorry and we'll try to do better in the future and fix those important issues much quicker!

Also thanks a ton for everyone that participated in our Open Community Playtest on Thursday this week! It was amazing and everyone tried some cool new secret features that aren't in the game yet  
I can say this: There will be more playtests in the future!

Onto more important news!
I have an important announcement to make: [i][b]We will be closing down the Demo starting on December 1st![/b][/i]

As we gear towards our Early Access release, we need the team to focus on some huge new features and improvements to the game, this means it's better for production of the game if we only have one version of the game to focus on. Because of this we decided to sunset the Demo starting December 1st so we can double down on making what matters: the Early Access version!

I want to add that we will keep doing Community Playtesting before EA Release, so if you want to participate join our discord @ discord.gg/bitcake!

We can't wait to show you more!

notes.title: New Update: Movement 2.0 and Cross Region Play!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, a new update just dropped in time for the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/roguelikecelebration2023]Roguelike Celebration[/url]!

We've teased it before on our [url=www.discord.gg/bitcake]Discord[/url], but here it finally is: The Movement 2.0 update!
Also, as a bonus, another highly requested feature: Cross Region play!

[h1]Features[/h1]
[h2]New Mechanic: Super Jump[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/f2ce7a425fb6254d4cdd8b37d3df4798dab6a983.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Pressing Space after Gear Dodging will activate the Super Jump!
[*] Enables a whole new layer of Movement Tech in the game!
[/list]
[h2]New Mechanic: Ledge Climb[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/8829a5055605433b735e7d9897f078fbc0e533a7.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] While jumping towards a ledge or when falling near it, your character will automatically climb up!
[*] You're now able to reach heights you weren't able to before, and movement through the map feels much more fluid!
[/list]
[h2]Improved Mechanic: Gear Dodge[/h2]
[list]
[*] Dodging near Cliffs won't pull you down anymore, it'll pull you forward instead!
[*] Improved Dodging upwards while on a Cliff!
[/list]
[h2]New Feature: Cross Region Play[/h2]
[list]
[*] You're now able to play with anyone, anywhere in the world! (Just beware of your ping!)
[/list]
[h2]Optimizations and Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Significant performance improvements of our AI Pathfinding
[*] Other smaller bugfixes and overall improvements
[/list]

[h1]Director's Commentary [/h1]
We're finally able to release this one! We've been working on this for a while, our animator had a lot of fun doing some new parkour movements. It was super fun watching the team play with the Lege Climb for the first time, once they experimented it they never wanted to play the game without it again 🤣

The Super Jump is a mechanic born out of a byproduct of our Dodge, where some players were able to do a super jump when precisely timing the jump after dodging, so we were like "why not turn this into and ACTUAL mechanic?" and we did! And that's because you guys loved it so much :)

As always: there's more coming in the future, stay tuned!

notes.title: The biggest update in Atomic Picnic's History! 😮😮
notes.content:
WOAH, that is a BOLD title! 
But yes, it is our biggest update yet.

Since the last time we came out of our caves, we've been hard at work reworking many systems from scratch to deliver some significant changes to how the game is fundamentally played.
This has resulted in a massive update with a lot of new content, but more importantly, the Game's main objective has changed, and that will have a lot of ripple effects going forward!

Now instead of surviving for 10 minutes, the game is now about completing objectives! There's also a completely new Game Mechanic: Devices, which are cool throwables that have different effects.
That's not all: during the match, you may stumble upon Random Events, Piñatas might drop some different pickups, you'll face new enemies, and more!

Oh, and did we mention you can now play all of that in offline single-player?


[h1]Features[/h1]
[h2]New Game Mechanic: Objectives![/h2]
We've completely revamped the Main Objective of a Picnic! The game is not about surviving a timer anymore, now it's about completing objectives and defeating bosses!
It's not only that but the longer the Picnic takes, the more difficult the game becomes 😈

[h2]New Game Mechanic: Devices[/h2]
[h3]Device: Estalo[/h3]
This isn't your regular bombs! Estalos are special grenades that bounce and might explode at up to 3 times! Each time it explodes it deals damage to enemies inside its area.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/3d92fab8908f3369ae907e7e88fb3ba8117f2aae.gif[/img]

[h3]Device: Chamusca[/h3]
Burn the world with Chamusca! A device that creates a fiery area that deals damage over time to enemies inside!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/08ee197fb4b3c8be93ccbcc5be7fefd520f3c410.gif[/img]

[h3]Device: Friaca[/h3]
Absolute Zero Chills with this one! Stop enemies in their tracks and make it easier for you to explode their faces!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/a7e36320f409f7b3acfbd235a3fc8e0cdea6b08d.gif[/img]

[h2]New Game Mechanic: Events[/h2]
During a Picnic, you might encounter special "happenings" that the Zone might spawn. These are special Events that you can participate in! But beware because the Zone has a chaotic personality so be careful before interacting with Events!
New Events will be introduced in the future!

[h3]New Event: Offerings[/h3]
The Zone will hide this event on the map, you need to find it to receive its rewards, but beware! It's not the Zone who's making an offering, YOU are the Offering...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/b6909d47ebd24ee243184657076302ea29e22cc4.png[/img]

[h2]New Game Mechanic: Vacuum Drops[/h2]
Now you can find new things hidden when breaking those Yellow Rocks! These are Vacuum Pickups, they do what their name say: they suck either the XP or Pebbles on the map to you!
[h3]XP Vacuum[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/50128e1f1e247194f1b284332b41bf5ff29b69e5.gif[/img]

[h3]Pebble Vacuum[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/1dff7e2a164d5e1fb5071a77a3a99e1fbd39ddf0.gif[/img]

[h2]New Enemy: Wisp[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/1956085e9a4019035951808a6fe10da7a3032f46.gif[/img]

[h2]New Enemy: Charger[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/e6db67d6fb1bb2b773a20920ca2e34ba43d18a2f.gif[/img]

[h2]New Drop System[/h2]
We've revamped how XP and Pebble drops work, now they can merge! Not only that but they are way more performant and the game should run much smoother when there's tons of drops on the map!
[h3]XP Merge[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/610a529b0ffd6b26fdb12178e17a4b7fdf7496c0.gif[/img]

[h3]Pebble Merge[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/7cd94baa6cfb3e91167794ab9f8b9681f3ddc4d1.gif[/img]

[h2]New Character Animations[/h2]
[h3]Take Damage[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/e01fcb842bdc643cf60cb63c5ec247d11a8f68e9.gif[/img]

[h3]Low Health[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/b20e2162cfe96f5e7f0ad126bfdb02d6c4922be2.gif[/img]

[h2]Match Flow Improvements[/h2]
We've removed the map that players spawned in before the Match starts. This means there's less friction from when you press Play to actually Play the game.
Now players will drop right into the map, the Upgrade popup will appear, and the match will start once everyone has chosen!

[h2]Rebalanced... everything[/h2]
Yep. Every weapon, upgrade, XP curve, drops, enemies, and enemy waves were rebalanced or changed in some way...
I'm not going to write everything here because this patch notes would be so big that you'd be spending the next 4 hours reading it. It's totally not because it's too much, and we didn't even keep track of everything...

[h2]Camera Improvements[/h2]
You'll notice that the game feels much more comfortable when fighting airborne enemies. This is because we changed how the camera behaves when looking up after certain angles. Grass won't get in front of the camera anymore, and the game will be framed better when looking up.

[h2]Visual Improvements[/h2]
Lots of visual improvements on the map
[list]
[*] New Graffiti Decals
[*] Better 3d Models
[*] Improved Textures and Shaders
[/list]
Added a new Dither Effect for grass and the player character when the camera gets too close.

[h2]Misc[/h2]
We've done a ton of optimizations, and the game should run much better on low-end machines!

---

[h1]Director's Commentary[/h1]

This was a big one!
The team is super proud of achieving so much in such a short period of time. And it doesn't stop here! Did you notice a small easter egg plastered across this entire update? No? Go back and look at all the GIFs and see if you notice something...

Yep. That's our new map! 
This new map will be coming soon to the game, so you can expect more info to drop in the coming weeks!  
If you were a member of our Discord.gg/bitcake, you'd have already seen some teases of it. If you aren't a member yet, join us there!

We are also cooking more Events, some cool mechanics, and the boss fight we teased last time is getting better and better 😈. Check our Discord for updates and sneak peeks of the boss fight as well!

See you all in the next update,
Cheers!

notes.title: 👊This NEW UPDATE is one to remember! 🤔
notes.content:
[h1]THIS ONE IS ONE TO REMEMBER![/h1]

This update took a bit more time than usual but for good reason. We did a lot of code cleanup and game optimizations to improve framerate due to all the new Art assets we added in, the game should be running a bit more smoothly, and hopefully, some crashes were fixed along the way. We also added the new Meta Progression system called Mementos! You can now bring the Pebbles you find during your playthrough and use them to upgrade your stats forever!

[h1]Features[/h1]
[h2]Mementos![/h2]
This is the start of the new Meta Progression system! With Mementos, you're now able to spend the Pebbles you find during the match to upgrade your character for future runs!

[h2]Remodeled Ash![/h2]
We've taken our time to remodel the Main Character! She's now missing one arm 😢 We also added her Ponytail with Physics!

[h2]A New Currency: Core![/h2]
Little Mac is a bit more generous now! He drops a new special currency called Core that you can use in Mementos to purchase some high-level upgrades!

[h2]More Maney![/h2]
You'll now be able to find different amount of Pebbles when breaking Crystals! There's now a 10 and 50 Pebble drop! Although we're still working on their specific Visual Effects

[h2]Redone XP Curve![/h2]
The XP Curve was remade! You'll find it way easier to get some early levels, and you will be able to level up a bit more during regular runs!

[h2]Enemy VFX![/h2]
There's a ton of new VFX for enemies like Slash Attack for the Fodder, a Pre-Shooting VFX for Shooting enemies, and some Muzzles! This should improve the gameplay experience by a lot! :wink: 

[h2]Music and SFX![/h2]
The game now has some Music, finally! We also added a lot of new Sound Effects, and they will keep coming! Oh, and we will work on some more music as well, so stay tuned!

[h2]Fixes and Improvements[/h2]
- Optimized the game BY A LOT!
- Fixed some bugs and crashes! Please report anything that you might find!

---

[h1]Director's Commentary[/h1]
Hey everyone! The Team worked very hard on this one! Many systems had to be either refactored or created from scratch for the new Mementos system! The good thing is that with this work done, adding more on top of it should be a breeze

The work we did on optimizations was no joke, we spent a lot of time making sure our systems were on top performance. We still have a lot of work to do, but this was also very important to continue working and expanding the game further!

Let us know what you think, and please report any bugs or errors you might find!

Cheers!

notes.content:
[h1]ːcocobotːːcocobotːːcocobotː This update is AGGRO! ːcocobotːːcocobotːːcocobotː[/h1]

[h2]ːholopackː Features ːholopackː[/h2]
[h3]New Map Area![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314424/d1ac94c4a6560a58ccbc79be344127aa2992efc5.jpg[/img]
A train station where loading and unloading happened before the Harvest Festival has appeared in The Zone! It's a verticality heaven with lots of jumping points and ways to escape from the enemies!

[h3]Two New Enemies![/h3]
[b]Bomb Launcher[/b]
This monster is not very movable, but he'll launch grenades at you from a huge distance so be careful! And if you dare get close you're in for a surprise ːhddeadː

[b]Flying Bomber[/b]
Those monsters launch 3 bombs at you at the same time, but those are sticky ones! So be careful where you walk!

[h3]Itch.io Update![/h3]
- Itch is now on the same version as Steam and you can play together by sharing the Room Code

[h2]Enemies Rebalance[/h2]
- Added 2 new enemies to the Waves
- Changes Spawn ratio of certain enemies
- Snake's Bullet doesn't go through walls anymore
- Reduced Snake's Health
- Other enemy stats rebalancing

[h2]Visuals[/h2]
- Added A TON of new Art to the Map!
- The Shop now has a new model and textures!
- Improved visuals on the Silos part of the Map
- Added Slow VFX when inside Little Mac's Slow Area

[h2]Fixes and Improvements[/h2]
[b]Upgraded our Character Controller[/b]
- Fixed an issue where Ash would keep bouncing forever when trying to climb certain objects
- Fixed an issue where Ash would jitter when sliding on certain slopes
- Ash's maximum walkable slope angle has been reduced from 62 degrees to 42.5 (This will make it harder to stay on top of certain trees).

[b]Bugfixes and Optimizations[/b]
- Fixed a lot of Crashes that were happening
- Started optimizing our Net Code
- Fixed A LOT of small errors that were happening and causing certain strange stuff to happen (like dead enemies spawning)

---

[h3]Director's Commentary[/h3]
This update marks the start of our efforts into making combat a lot more interesting. With two new enemy types released and some more in the works, we want to keep combat super fast paced and interesting during the entire duration of the run. We also did a lot of enemy tweaking like reducing/changing some spawns here and there and changing some behaviors like the Snake's Bullet not going through walls anymore.

We also focused a lot on the game's Stability, we identified some issues that were causing Crashes and we went hard on fixing those, the side-effects of this is not only Crashes being fixed but the game running MUCH smoother. We want to keep solving stability issues on a higher priority than other issues, so please keep reporting any crashes or things that are game-breaking! :smile:

As always, thank you SO VERY MUCH for playing Atomic and helping us make it better and better!

See you on the next update!
